traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration after a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: You gain an Origin feat of your choice.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.description: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a lineage; you gain its level 1 benefit, and at character levels 3 and 5 you learn a higher-level spell that you always have prepared (castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with any slot of the appropriate level). Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select the lineage).

options.name: Drow
options.description: Your Darkvision range increases to 120 feet, and you know the Dancing Lights cantrip. Lvl 3: Faerie Fire. Lvl 5: Darkness.

options.name: High Elf
options.description: You know the Prestidigitation cantrip (you can swap it for another Wizard cantrip after each Long Rest). Lvl 3: Detect Magic. Lvl 5: Misty Step.

options.name: Wood Elf
options.description: Your Speed increases to 35 feet, and you know the Druidcraft cantrip. Lvl 3: Longstrider. Lvl 5: Pass without Trace.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: Choose the ability you use to cast the spells granted by your lineage. (Defaults to your highest of Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma until set.)

options.name: Intelligence
options.description: Cast your innate lineage spells using Intelligence.

options.name: Wisdom
options.description: Cast your innate lineage spells using Wisdom.

options.name: Charisma
options.description: Cast your innate lineage spells using Charisma.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, you gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You must be on a stone surface or touching one (natural or worked) to use this Tremorsense. You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: Your lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. Your choice sets the damage type of your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance traits as well as your appearance.

options.name: Black Dragon
options.description: Acid damage.

options.name: Blue Dragon
options.description: Lightning damage.

options.name: Brass Dragon
options.description: Fire damage.

options.name: Bronze Dragon
options.description: Lightning damage.

options.name: Copper Dragon
options.description: Acid damage.

options.name: Gold Dragon
options.description: Fire damage.

options.name: Green Dragon
options.description: Poison damage.

options.name: Red Dragon
options.description: Fire damage.

options.name: Silver Dragon
options.description: Cold damage.

options.name: White Dragon
options.description: Cold damage.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide (choose the shape each time). Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes the rolled damage of the type set by your Draconic Ancestry; on a success, half as much. The damage is 1d10, increasing to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 11, and 4d10 at level 17. You can use this a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses on a Long Rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.description: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.description: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a lineage; Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells it grants (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

options.name: Forest Gnome
options.description: You know the Minor Illusion cantrip and always have Speak with Animals prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest, or with any spell slots you have.

options.name: Rock Gnome
options.description: You know the Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips. You can spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP). You can have three such devices at a time; each falls apart after 8 hours or when you dismantle it.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: Choose the ability you use to cast the spells granted by your lineage. (Defaults to your highest of Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma until set.)

options.name: Intelligence
options.description: Cast your innate lineage spells using Intelligence.

options.name: Wisdom
options.description: Cast your innate lineage spells using Wisdom.

options.name: Charisma
options.description: Cast your innate lineage spells using Charisma.

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.description: You are descended from Giants. Choose one boon; you can use the chosen benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses on a Long Rest.

options.name: Cloud's Jaunt (Cloud Giant)
options.description: As a Bonus Action, you magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

grantedActions.name: Cloud's Jaunt
grantedActions.description: Magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

options.name: Fire's Burn (Fire Giant)
options.description: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage to it.

options.name: Frost's Chill (Frost Giant)
options.description: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage, you can also deal 1d6 Cold damage and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

options.name: Hill's Tumble (Hill Giant)
options.description: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage, you can give that target the Prone condition.

options.name: Stone's Endurance (Stone Giant)
options.description: When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d12, add your Constitution modifier, and reduce the damage by that total.

grantedActions.name: Stone's Endurance
grantedActions.description: When you take damage, roll and reduce that damage by the total.

options.name: Storm's Thunder (Storm Giant)
options.description: When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.

grantedActions.name: Storm's Thunder
grantedActions.description: When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet, deal Thunder damage to it.

traits.name: Large Form
traits.description: Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action if you're in a big enough space. This lasts 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can't stop in the same space.

traits.name: Luck
traits.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: You can take the Hide action even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.description: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.description: You are the recipient of a legacy that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a legacy; you gain its level 1 benefit, and at character levels 3 and 5 you learn a higher-level spell that you always have prepared (castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with any slot of the appropriate level). Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select the legacy).

options.name: Abyssal
options.description: You have Resistance to Poison damage and know the Poison Spray cantrip. Lvl 3: Ray of Sickness. Lvl 5: Hold Person.

options.name: Chthonic
options.description: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage and know the Chill Touch cantrip. Lvl 3: False Life. Lvl 5: Ray of Enfeeblement.

options.name: Infernal
options.description: You have Resistance to Fire damage and know the Fire Bolt cantrip. Lvl 3: Hellish Rebuke. Lvl 5: Darkness.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: Choose the ability you use to cast the spells granted by your lineage. (Defaults to your highest of Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma until set.)

options.name: Intelligence
options.description: Cast your innate lineage spells using Intelligence.

options.name: Wisdom
options.description: Cast your innate lineage spells using Wisdom.

options.name: Charisma
options.description: Cast your innate lineage spells using Charisma.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. When you cast it with this trait, the spell uses the same spellcasting ability you use for your Fiendish Legacy trait.
